title: Record, then settle, a launch creator fee claim
description: PUT /api/social/me/launch-claims/{request_id} (LP-12): the launch and which ledger's fees, the curve's or the migration vault's; then the same body with the signed transaction's digest, or with why nothing was sent. Never both. The server finds the cap and the vault.

transaction_bytes.description: Canonical base64 full Sui TransactionData bytes, sent with the first digest. Its digest and sender must match the caller’s Blast wallet.
